chapter: Learning the drums and first job
title: Starting on drums on the steps
summary: He began on drums at about 15, beating on the steps, and got his first drums around 19.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah. Can you tell me about your very first instrument, what you started on? Was it drums or what?
Drums. I used to play on the steps and different things like that until I bought a drum. And then after I bought a snare drum. I, uh...
About how old were you when you started beating on the steps even?
Oh, I was a kid around about 15.
Yeah. And how old were you when you got your first drums?
Well, about 19 years. I was about 19 years.
